Hi Tom / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick written recap + the short bench readout I promised attached. Key highlights from the microbench we ran against the model you mentioned (open-vanguard-13B, 4k context):

- p50 token latency: ~18 ms (single-request, no batching)
- p95 token latency: ~48 ms
- p99 token latency: ~85 ms (observed on 8k prompt, cold KV)
- Sustained throughput (continuous 1k token streams): ~95–120 tokens/sec per GPU; with continuous batching we can push effective throughput >200 tokens/sec for parallelized request patterns

Answered Qs from the call:
1) Batch sizing: For small bursty traffic (1–8 concurrent requests) we recommend batching window of 20–40 ms — keeps p95 in the 40–60 ms range.
2) Cold vs warm KV cache: cold p99 is where you saw the spike; with prefix caching we reduce p99 by ~30–40% on repeated contexts.
3) SLA: baseline 99.5% availability for Dedicated; see the attached SLA summary for options and credits.

Attachments: data-voice-bench-20260922.csv (raw numbers), redwood-deploy-plan.pdf (high-level rollout suggestion).

Next suggested steps:
- Technical sync with your infra (we can do a 30m call w/ our perf engineer)
- If infra signs off, we'll prepare an eval cluster for a week (free) to reproduce these numbers on your workload

Proposed times for the tech sync: Thu 9/24 10:00–11:00 PT, Fri 9/25 14:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, tell me where to send a calendar poll.
